ops.text:
ROOT CAUSE, read directly from launchd's unified log during a captured failing brew postinstall (2026-07-26, local machine): "Caller not allowed to perform action: launchctl.36480, action = service bootstrap (/private/tmp/captain-hook-postinstall-20260726-36383-qp2lw4/Library/LaunchAgents/com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper.plist, io flags=0x100000, eval flags=0), code = 1: Operation not permitted" — repeated 6×, one per daemonkit retry. Homebrew runs formula postinstall under a SANDBOXED TEMP HOME; daemonkit resolves the LaunchAgents plist location from $HOME, so under brew it writes and bootstraps the plist at the temp path, and launchd refuses to bootstrap a LaunchAgent from an untrusted temp location with EPERM. launchctl surfaces exit 5; daemonkit's launchctlInFluxExit=5 misclassifies the permanent denial as transient, retries 6×, and emits a session-type-flavored diagnostic — the misdirecting message that cost nine falsified hypotheses.

Exonerations sealed by the same log: process identity (the failing chain launchctl←capt-hookd←ruby←zsh←fish←Orca shares the succeeding tests' Orca ancestry and asid=100025 exactly — only the path differs), the enable step (7 successful enable entries interleaved with the 6 bootstrap refusals), all four spawn attributes, and every plist-content mechanism. Every manual success passed an explicit ~/Library/LaunchAgents path; every failure let daemonkit compute the path under brew's temp HOME. Note: yasyf-home's reposync-helper cell (Background key, real HOME, SSH) is a SEPARATE mechanism not covered by this root cause — its fix (keyless emission, synckit v0.36.3) is released and awaits the desired-set recovery unwedge (002e2e9a).

FIX (in implementation, fable lane): resolve user-home-derived durable paths through the passwd database instead of $HOME (with a deliberate test-override seam), and declassify launchctl exit 5 from blanket-transient, surfacing the bootstrapped plist path in the diagnostic. Fix release + field confirmation (a previously-failing machine converging through brew postinstall) close this arc via investigation_fix + confirm. Tooling note for future capture: `log` is a zsh builtin — unified-log capture from zsh must use /usr/bin/log.
